dsh-plugin-image-input 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

posts.en:
dsh-plugin-image-input is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-01bbac90b4d2ebd2623e.html
